# Switch

`ui.switch` · parts: `Switch` · elements: `<button>`

## Purpose

Switch is an on/off toggle: button[role=switch] with aria-checked.
State changes are the consumer's (onClick via attrs/rest).

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
- Renders a `<button role="switch">` with `aria-checked`; wire the toggle yourself (click handler via rest/attrs).
- Always give an accessible name: `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or text children.
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Switch renders button[type=button][role=switch]; children render the thumb.

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

## ARIA

- Always rendered: `role="switch"`.
- Computed/forwarded: `aria-checked`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` (omitted when empty).
- Typed ARIA props: `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` — static values only.

## Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `switchClasses({ ... })` from `switch/switch.shared.ts` |
| templ | `formswitch.SwitchClasses(formswitch.SwitchProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('switchClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::switchClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `switch_classes(p)` |

## Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="false" data-state="false">Content</button>` |
| on | `{"Checked":true,"AriaLabel":"Wi-Fi"}` | `<button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="true" data-state="true" aria-label="Wi-Fi">Content</button>` |
| disabled | `{"Disabled":true,"Name":"s","Value":"on","ID":"sw","AriaLabelledBy":"l"}` | `<button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="false" data-state="false" disabled id="sw" name="s" value="on" aria-labelledby="l">Content</button>` |
| Checked | `{"Checked":true}` | `<button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="true" data-state="true">Content</button>` |
| Disabled | `{"Disabled":true}` | `<button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="false" data-state="false" disabled>Content</button>` |

## Usage

Fixture `on` (`{"Checked":true,"AriaLabel":"Wi-Fi"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked="true" data-state="true" aria-label="Wi-Fi">Content</button>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Switch } from "./ui/switch/switch";

<Switch checked aria-label="Wi-Fi">Content</Switch>
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Switch from "./ui/switch/Switch.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Switch checked aria-label="Wi-Fi">Content</Switch>
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte

  import Switch from "./ui/switch/Switch.svelte";
</script>

<Switch checked={true} aria-label="Wi-Fi">Content</Switch>
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
import { Switch } from "./ui/switch/switch.solid";

<Switch checked aria-label="Wi-Fi">Content</Switch>
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts
import { renderSwitch } from "./ui/switch/switch.wc";

document.body.append(renderSwitch({ checked: true, "aria-label": "Wi-Fi" }, "Content"));
```

```

```
